rules.headings: Uppercase or Sentence case. Always tight tracking. No gradients on text unless for specific emphasis.
rules.body: High readability. good contrast. Loose leading.

grid_system.bento_marketing: Use 'Tetris' grid: mix of col-span-4, col-span-6, and col-span-8. No equal rows.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-12 px-8 rounded-none skew-x-[-10deg] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider transition-all duration-300 hover:skew-x-[0deg] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.5)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/20 text-white hover:bg-white/10 h-12 px-8 rounded-none uppercase tracking-wider backdrop-blur-md transition-all

product.base: group relative bg-surface border border-white/5 overflow-hidden transition-all duration-300 hover:border-primary/50
product.image: aspect-[3/4] object-cover w-full opacity-80 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-500 scale-100 group-hover:scale-105
product.content: absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full p-6 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 to-transparent
product.overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-primary/10 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300 mix-blend-overlay

cards.feature: bg-surface_highlight border border-white/5 p-8 rounded-xl hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors

inputs.base: bg-black/50 border-white/10 focus:border-primary text-white placeholder:text-white/30 h-12 rounded-md transition-all focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50

navigation.header: fixed top-0 w-full z-40 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5 h-20 flex items-center justify-between px-8

visual_enhancers.noise: fixed inset-0 w-full h-full pointer-events-none z-50 opacity-[0.03] bg-[url('https://grainy-gradients.vercel.app/noise.svg')]

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a global Layout wrapper that includes the Noise overlay and Navbar.
Ensure all buttons have the 'group' class to enable hover effects on children.
Use the 'Space Grotesk' font for all headings (h1-h3) and 'Outfit' for body text. Add these to index.html or import in CSS.
Create a reusable 'Section' component that handles the padding (py-24) and max-width container automatically.
For the Product Detail Page, use a 'Sticky Sidebar' layout for the purchase card on desktop.
Admin Dashboard should use a Sidebar layout (left nav) and use the 'surface_highlight' color for the main content area to distinguish from the black sidebar.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text on image backgrounds has a text-shadow or a dark gradient overlay.
accessibility.focus: Custom focus ring: ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 ring-offset-black

testing.data_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'hero-cta-button', 'product-card-1', 'nav-login-link').
